name: What problems can happen if kitchen appliance hookups are not properly coordinated?

mainEntity.name: What problems can happen if kitchen appliance hookups are not properly coordinated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper coordination prevents costly delays, drywall tear-outs, and delivery re-stocking fees. High-end or specialized appliances often demand specific circuit amperages, exact water supply placements, or dedicated cabinet ventilation channels. If these rough-ins are placed a few inches off, appliances may protrude past countertop overhangs or fail safety inspections. Careful trade oversight ensures utility rough-ins match appliance technical drawings on the first attempt.
acceptedAnswer.description: Poor coordination leads to misaligned rough-ins, appliances protruding past countertops, drywall tear-outs to move pipes, and potential inspection failures or delivery delays.
